summary: Nebius Group N.V. announced a proposed private offering of $4.50 billion convertible senior notes in two series: $2.75 billion due 2030 and $1.75 billion due 2034, with an option for initial purchasers to buy up to an additional $675 million. Proceeds fund data-center build-out and general corporate purposes. Concurrently, the company expects to enter into privately negotiated exchange agreements with holders of existing 2029 and 2031 convertibles to swap notes for Class A shares, potentially creating overhang and impacting share price. The offering is not contingent on these exchanges. Watch for pricing terms, conversion premiums, and exchange transaction details for risk-arb opportunities.
